body:
## Pull request overview

Prepares the monorepo for release **v0.4.1**, primarily to synchronize package versions (notably bringing `@objectstack/plugin-msw` up to the same release line) and update accompanying release documentation.

**Changes:**
- Bumped core package versions from `0.4.0` → `0.4.1` and aligned plugin peer dependency ranges to `^0.4.1`.
- Updated example app versions and dependency ranges to reference `0.4.1`.
- Added/updated release documentation: root `CHANGELOG.md`, per-package changelogs, and `RELEASE_NOTES.md`.

The 0.4.1 changelog entry references syncing plugin-msw to 0.4.0 and updating runtime peer dependency versions to ^0.4.0, which conflicts with this PR’s 0.4.1 release and this package’s actual dependency setup. Please correct the 0.4.1 entry so it reflects the real 0.4.1 changes.
```suggestion
- Patch release with dependency updates
```

The 0.4.1 changelog entry still mentions 0.4.0 (plugin-msw sync and runtime peer dependency versions). This is inconsistent with the 0.4.1 release and doesn’t match this package’s package.json (no runtime peerDependencies). Please update the 0.4.1 entry to be accurate.
```suggestion
  - Aligned internal dependencies with the 0.4.1 release
  - Fixed internal dependency version mismatches

- Updated dependencies
  - @objectstack/spec@0.4.1
  - @objectstack/spec@0.4.1
```

This changelog now contains two consecutive "## 0.1.1" sections. The older section (with @objectstack/spec@0.4.0) should remain under 0.1.0 (or be removed) and the new 0.1.1 entry should be the only 0.1.1 heading. Please de-duplicate and ensure version ordering is correct.

This changelog has duplicate "## 0.1.1" headings (one referencing @objectstack/spec@0.4.1 and another referencing @objectstack/spec@0.4.0). Please de-duplicate and ensure the older dependency update is under the correct prior version (likely 0.1.0) so the changelog is valid.

The 0.4.1 changelog entry still references 0.4.0 (plugin-msw sync and runtime peer dependency versions). This is inconsistent with the 0.4.1 release and also appears to describe changes (runtime peer deps) that don’t apply to this package (it has no peerDependencies). Update these bullets to reflect the actual 0.4.1 changes for @objectstack/spec.

The 0.4.1 changelog entry mentions syncing plugin-msw to 0.4.0 and updating runtime peer dependency versions to ^0.4.0. That’s inconsistent with the 0.4.1 release and also doesn’t match this package’s package.json (no runtime peerDependencies). Please correct the versions/wording so the changelog matches the actual 0.4.1 changes.

In the 0.4.1 changelog entry, the bullets still reference 0.4.0 (plugin-msw sync and “runtime peer dependency versions”). This is inconsistent with the 0.4.1 release, and @objectstack/runtime doesn’t declare peerDependencies in package.json. Please update this entry to accurately describe the 0.4.1 changes.

The new 0.4.1 changelog entry still says plugin-msw was synchronized to 0.4.0 and runtime peer dependency versions were updated to ^0.4.0. That doesn’t align with the 0.4.1 release and this package doesn’t manage runtime peer deps. Please fix the versions/wording in this entry.
```suggestion

  - Updated development and build-time dependency versions
```
